feedback.description: this memory records a correction somebody gave, and who gave it

memory.description: one thing a person said about how they want something built or handled, kept in their own words. The words themselves are the entity's doc.body, verbatim; this says where they belong and what is needed to read them. The byline is the entity's created{at, by}

space.description: whose place they were said in — every member of it reads them, and they die with it

about.description: the app they were said about, by slug, when they were about one

context.description: the line or two needed to understand the words — what was being talked about, never a restatement of what was said
